records.name: Nepal
records.summary_text:
Nepal is workable for trans visitors — South Asia's most legally recognising country. The Supreme Court has protected gender identity since a landmark 2007 ruling; a third-gender category exists on documents by self-identification; and in 2024 the Supreme Court ruled that a trans woman must be recognised as female without medical verification. Nothing is criminalised, and Kathmandu, the capital, has an established activist scene.
